title: What's new in the World Development Indicators, October 2026: poverty and inequality updates, new food security & nutrition data, latest energy statistics
gist: The World Bank's October 2026 World Development Indicators release refreshes poverty (through 2025), food security (2024), governance, labor, balance of payments, military spending and energy data, and highlights global clean cooking access at 75 percent in 2024.

insights.claim: The October 2026 WDI update refreshed poverty and inequality indicators through 2025 at the $3.00, $4.20 and $8.30 a day lines (2021 PPP), plus Gini, income shares and bottom-40 shared prosperity.
insights.speaker: @worldbank
insights.so_what: Latest official poverty benchmarks for macro and frontier-market research.

insights.claim: The release adds FAO food security data through 2024, ILO labor indicators, IMF balance of payments data on FDI, remittances and current accounts, Worldwide Governance Indicators through 2025, and military expenditure and arms transfers for 2025.
insights.speaker: @worldbank
insights.so_what: Source list for refreshed country-risk datasets.

insights.claim: IEA energy statistics were refreshed with 2024 data for non-OECD economies and 2025 data for selected OECD electricity indicators, alongside new FAO fertilizer, land use and cereal yield data.
insights.speaker: @worldbank
insights.so_what: Updated inputs for energy and agriculture modeling.

insights.claim: By 2024, 75 percent of people worldwide had access to clean cooking fuels and technologies, around 90 percent in urban areas versus 56 percent in rural areas.
insights.speaker: @worldbank
insights.so_what: The remaining energy-access gap is concentrated in rural areas.

insights.claim: South Asia's rural clean cooking access rose from 6 percent in 2000 to 62 percent in 2024, and Indonesia and Viet Nam each raised rural access by 82 percentage points over 24 years, while Sub-Saharan Africa remains far behind.
insights.speaker: @worldbank
insights.so_what: Sub-Saharan Africa is the main frontier for clean cooking demand and policy.
